text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: In search of the ultimate cup! I've arrived at the campsite! It's a relief not seeing any familiar faces. After all, my purpose is my purpose... Especially if {0}-kun were to see me, what would he say...
text_block_list.orig_text:
最高の一杯を求めて！　
やってきたわよ、
キャンプ場！
知り合いの姿も見えないし一安心ね。
なにせ目的が目的だもの……
特に{0}くんに見られたら、
なんて言われるか……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Don't you want more than one cup? Hehehe, barley fizz... is the best! But he wouldn't say something like that, would he?! Ah... I'm getting more excited than I thought. Could it be the camp high?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一杯で我慢しなくていいの？　
うふふっ、
麦しゅわ……
さいっこーーー☆
って、
彼がそんなこと言うはずないじゃな～い！？
あー……
私、
思ったより浮かれてるわね。
キャンプハイかしら？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: ...He might say that if he's a kind person. It would make me happy to receive affirmation... Hehehe♪ Wait, what am I thinking about in the middle of the day? I'm getting too carried away, aren't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なーんて、
優しい彼なら言ってくれるかも。
肯定してもらえたら、
うれしいし……
えへへ♪
って、
昼間から何を考えてるの、
私っ！？　
開放的になりすぎじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: If he were to say that, it would be nice... But it's still too early for him. ...Alright, I need to study hard so that when the day comes when I can have a drink with him, I'll be prepared. Let's do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言われたら、
それはそれでいいけど……
彼にはまだ早いわよね。
……よし、
いつか彼と飲める日が来たときのために、
お姉さんがしっかり予習しておかなくちゃ！　
さぁ、
やるわよ～！
